theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ z ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ z) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M θ x T → ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ (C : ℝ) (g : Eucl P → ℝ), (∀ w, |g w| ≤ C) → (∀ w, R < ‖w‖ → g w = 0) → |∫ w in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, g w * θ (x + r • w) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))| ≤ C * B
